prohibited_inferences: Do not treat the v15 extension or PC-17 fixture as evidence that any named judgment settlement fund escrow insurer customer successor or affected population did or did not receive remedy.
Do not infer collection from a judgment settlement award escrow announcement bond payment promise or public remedy label.
Do not infer usable collective standing or population coverage from nominal eligibility notice a representative title or an individual claim route.
Do not infer affected-party payment from payment to a customer trustee administrator insurer court fund or other intermediary.
Do not infer durable compensation from gross or provisional payment subject to appeal stay clawback recoupment discharge or reversal.
Do not infer insolvency priority distribution claim survival or successor recovery from filing allowance continued service acquisition merger or assignment alone.
Do not infer monetary restoration from technical nonmonetary corrective or monitoring completion.
Do not infer breach negligence causation misconduct manipulation or intent from an uncollected unpaid stayed discharged or excluded obligation alone.
Do not infer public authorization from collective standing payment enforcement monitoring or completed remedy.
Do not treat the seventeen-control floor as exhaustive of every legal economic constitutional security social or performative failure mode.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A compositional successor floor that preserves the qualified sixteen-control v14 base and adds PC-17 collective remedy standing finality security collection insolvency priority successor and durability equifinality without rewriting the frozen base controls.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A legal opinion collection finding insolvency-priority determination successor-liability conclusion public-authorization verdict named-organization allegation or complete universal theory of collective remedy enforcement.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: Preference Custody floor v15 composes the qualified v14 controls with PC-17. It separates nominal obligation from collective standing finality stay security pass-through take-up insolvency priority successor assumption gross payment durable compensation and residual obligation, while requiring real cases to preserve complete claimant instrument payment insolvency succession enforcement and authority custody.
